<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form C‑C bonds (as in a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition) using the target molecule SMILES. This should return templates whose forward reaction creates the needed bonds. Then I will check which returned template matches the target molecule and retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
